title: Interleaving String

story.title: Braiding Two Ropes
story.text: Can rope s3 be braided from s1 and s2 without reordering either? Each grid cell asks whether the first i strands of s1 and j of s2 braid into the first i+j of s3, by taking the next strand from either rope.
story.goal: Return true if s3 is an interleaving of s1 and s2.
